cards.text: Israel has seen the wall of Jericho fall (Joshua 6:20). But the Israelites acted unfaithfully regarding the things devoted to destruction. A man named Achan, from the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart.

cards.question: One man took the devoted things. Who does the anger of the LORD burn against?

cards.text: Meanwhile, Joshua, Israel's leader, sends men from Jericho to spy out Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel. I bet Israel is feeling pretty good after Jericho.

cards.question: The spies come back from Ai. True or false: they tell Joshua to send all the people up to attack it.

cards.text: They say two or three thousand men are enough, because the people of Ai are so few. That's me looking at one little batch of dough and deciding I don't need a timer for THIS one.

cards.question: So about three thousand Israelites go up to Ai. What happens?

answers.text: They flee before the men of Ai
They capture Ai in one day

cards.text: The men of Ai strike down about thirty-six Israelites, chasing them from the gate as far as the quarries and striking them down on the slopes. This one's heavy, friend.

cards.question: True or false: after the loss at Ai, the people of Israel lose heart.

cards.text: Joshua tears his clothes and falls facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening, and the elders of Israel do the same. They all sprinkle dust on their heads, and I think every one of them is heartbroken.

cards.question: Joshua asks the Lord GOD why He ever brought this people all this way, only to hand them over to the Amorites, a people of the land. What does Joshua wish they had done?

answers.text: Stayed on the other side of the Jordan
Stayed back in the land of Egypt
Waited longer in the camp at Jericho

cards.text: Then Joshua says, "O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?" That's a man who doesn't know what to say, and he says it anyway, straight to God.

cards.question: Joshua thinks ahead to when the Canaanites and everyone in the land hear about Ai. What does he say they will do?

answers.text: Surround Israel and wipe out its name

cards.question: True or false: Joshua finishes by asking what God will do for His great name.

cards.text: But the LORD says to Joshua, "Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face?"
The LORD tells him Israel has sinned and transgressed His covenant. They have taken some of what was devoted to destruction, stolen and lied, and put these things with their own possessions.

cards.question: The LORD says this is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies. What does He say has happened to the Israelites themselves?

answers.text: They have been set apart for destruction
They have forgotten how to fight
Their enemies have grown too strong

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says He will no longer be with Israel unless they remove what is devoted to destruction from among them.

cards.text: So the LORD tells Joshua to get up and have the people consecrate themselves for tomorrow. Friend, when I've got a big day tomorrow, I set FOUR oven timers and STILL wake up in the middle of the night to check on the dough.

cards.question: In the morning, all Israel must present themselves. How will the one with the devoted things be found?

answers.text: The LORD selects tribe by tribe down to one man
Joshua has every tent in the camp searched
Joshua has every man come and confess

cards.text: The LORD says the one caught with the devoted things must be burned, along with all that belongs to him.

cards.question: What reason does the LORD give for what will happen to the one caught with the devoted things?

answers.text: He transgressed the covenant of the LORD
He ran away from the battle at Ai
He refused to march around Jericho

cards.text: Early the next morning, Judah is selected, then the clan of the Zerahites, then the family of Zabdi, and the circle gets SMALLER and SMALLER. Then they come forward man by man, and Achan is selected.

cards.question: Joshua urges Achan to make a ___ to the LORD and not hide what he has done.

cards.text: Joshua even calls him "My son," and as a Papa, that one gets me. Achan replies, "It is true," and then, "I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel."

cards.question: Achan tells Joshua what he saw among the spoils. What did Achan take?

answers.text: A cloak and silver and a gold bar
A crown and a sword and a shield
Bronze pots and a few iron tools

cards.question: Achan says that when he saw the beautiful things among the spoils at Jericho, he ___ them and took them.
True or false: Achan says he buried the things he took somewhere outside the camp.

cards.text: Joshua's messengers RUN to Achan's tent. There it all is, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.

cards.question: The messengers bring Achan's things to Joshua and all the Israelites. What do they do with them?

answers.text: Spread them out before the LORD
Put them in the LORD's treasury
Bury them back in the ground

cards.text: Then Joshua and all Israel take Achan to the Valley of Achor, with the silver, the cloak and the gold bar. His sons and daughters, his animals, his tent and everything he owned are brought there too, and friend, this is a hard one to read.
Joshua says, "Why have you brought this trouble upon us?" and "Today the LORD will bring trouble upon you!" Then all Israel stones Achan to death, then stones the others and burns their bodies.

cards.question: True or false: after Achan is stoned, the LORD keeps burning with anger against Israel.

cards.text: They heap a large pile of rocks over Achan, still there when this was written, and the place was still called the Valley of Achor. But friend, Israel's story in this land isn't done yet.
